title: New patient welcome
description: Welcome a new patient with first-visit instructions and contact options. Welcome WhatsApp template for clinics. Free to copy and edit.
notes: Add practical items to bring. Phone button lets patients reach reception without leaving WhatsApp.

body.text: Welcome to {{clinic}}, {{first_name}}! For your first visit, please bring a photo ID and your insurance card. Questions? Our reception team is happy to help.
